meta.claim: Synthetic capability test. qrels are graph-derived. Constraints are built from query['text'] plus the graph only; query['type'], ['symbols'], ['module'], ['chain'], ['qid'] and ['qrels'] are never read by the parser, the plan builder or the selector. Oracle metadata appears only in diagnostic blocks labelled diagnostic_only.

parser.symbol_rule: tokens exactly matching graph.defined, path spans excised
parser.module_rule: literal file_imports match first, resolve_module fallback
parser.unsupported_policy: no guessing; fall back to the RRF baseline
